title: The Atlas splits into Immutable and Adaptive Documents so evolution cannot erode the framework's spirit
content:
A.0.1.1.16 describes the Atlas as the foundational rule set powering the Sky Ecosystem, composed of two document classes:

- **Immutable Documents** enshrine the Spirit of the Atlas and "become permanently immutable from the moment the Sky Ecosystem enters the Endgame State."
- **Adaptive Documents** "practically operationalize the Spirit of the Atlas" and are continuously improved through Sky Governance.

The stated purpose of the immutable half is defensive: it "ensures the aligned evolution of Sky: it mitigates the potential and actual damage caused by Slippery Slope Misalignment, which erodes the potency of Alignment Engineering over time."

This is a direct structural answer to the drift problem. A wholly adaptive framework can be walked anywhere by a sequence of individually defensible amendments; a wholly immutable one cannot respond to changing conditions. Splitting them puts the erodible material where erosion is cheap and fixes the part whose erosion would be fatal. The immutability is also *deferred* — it activates at the Endgame State, conceding that the spirit itself still needs refinement until then.
description: Immutable Documents enshrine the Spirit and become permanently fixed at the Endgame State; Adaptive Documents operationalize it and keep changing through governance.
